entry.title: Fact Check: NO Evidence 90,000 Drop In Votes In Nevada District 2 House Race Was Fraud -- An AP Typo
entry.summary: Does a brief vote spike followed by a sudden drop of 90,000 votes reported by the Associated Press in Nevada's House District 2 on Nov. 4, 2026, indicate election fraud? No, that's not true: An AP spokesperson told Lead Stories...
entry.content:
Does a brief vote spike followed by a sudden drop of 90,000 votes reported by the Associated Press in Nevada's House District 2 on Nov. 4, 2026, indicate election fraud? No, that's not true: An AP spokesperson told Lead Stories it was a glitch caused by a "vote-entry error" that was "quickly identified and corrected." The person who recorded the changes and posted about it on social media called it suspicious in an interview with Lead Stories, but he acknowledged he had no evidence that it was fraud.

entry.title: Fact Check: Trump DID 'Dump' Up To $1 Million In Nvidia Stock -- But Also Bought Up To $1.6 Million
entry.summary: Did President Donald Trump "dump" his Nvidia stock a few weeks before the Jensen Huang Chinese spy story dropped? Yes, but that is missing context: According to his financial disclosure, Trump sold between $500,001 and $1 million in Nvidia stock...
entry.content:
Did President Donald Trump "dump" his Nvidia stock a few weeks before the Jensen Huang Chinese spy story dropped? Yes, but that is missing context: According to his financial disclosure, Trump sold between $500,001 and $1 million in Nvidia stock on Aug. 21, about 10 weeks before the New York Times first reported on the alleged Chinese spy on Oct. 29. He also bought between $766,004 and $1.6 million in Nvidia stock that month.
